nodes.long_description:
The first VR game built entirely around your voice. No menus, no controllers, just real-time conversations and interactions.

Welcome to Stellar Cafe, a coffee shop at the edge of the galaxy filled with quirky robots with bizarre ambitions and a lot to say. Pull up a seat, order whatever you can imagine, and meet a rotating cast of unforgettable characters. You might end up helping a robot quit their job, be a guest on their podcast, or chase their dreams. Your voice steers the story.
{1967723817127350}

# Voice-First Gameplay

Speak to the robots and they speak back. No dialog trees, just direct understanding and interaction all in real-time. Be creative and expressive, conversations are fully dynamic and driven by your voice!

{2002995866913735}

# Hand Tracking

Use your hands, you want to grab it, do it! Reach, grab, sip, point and toss objects in your environment just like real-life. From adding creamer to your coffee to flinging a bottle of hot sauce at a robot, let both your hands and your voice do the talking.
{1230221762309262}

# Colorful Cast of Characters

Every robot has a unique personality, goals, and quirks.  Make a friend (or not) and uncover their stories.

Humor
Experience a new brand of humor where your voice helps drive the comedy.*

Supports English Language

*Performance and outcomes are subject to variability based on the individual. We are not liable for the lack of humor generated by the human. Side effects may include eye rolls, snorts, or the occasional "that was clever"
{2649382208746402}

nodes.change_log:
Faster response times - NPCs response even faster than before for a more real-time experience

Updated LLM and Text-to-Speech models

Reworked all LLM prompts to work better with newer models

Improved safety model support

James now won't make a drink until he has your name and offers a standard drink if you don't want a custom one

James on Cycle 3 updates the menu and makes your drink in one step instead

Fixed bug where James would sometimes try to look at robots not in cafe

Sarah keeps responses short while adjusting her head position, won't ask your name in repair mode, and replies more naturally

Carter won't force a second question if you already asked one and provides clearer "studying is over" signal

Carter’s study meter no longer fills too early

Toby’s buyers now have unique personalities that flavor their reviews

Toby better understands if he is on the last item in the buyer list

Debbie confirms your script submission and follows up with the next question correctly

Cindy will now ask you to be on the podcast only once

Kim wraps up only after the final prediction more reliably

Ted's email reply is now more specific to the email you sent

Poly chimes at a better cadence and is funnier

Robots will eventually ask you for help directly

Robots now only discuss the planets after you bring them up

Fixed robots looking from their actual eye position

VISOR now won't let you teleport to cafe tables until James places a drink in front of you

VISOR now knows it's in the transport pod with you and no longer auto-teleports you to the counter

Fixed a bug where bringing up VISOR didn't always pause the currently-speaking robot

Fixed memories sometimes breaking on load

Various performance, lighting, and visual fixes
